lines.text: The ash ward crumbles at your touch. The door grinds inward, and cold air breathes out of the dark.

lines.speaker: Blade Assassin
lines.text: Three graves, three names, and you dug up every one of them. How diligent.

lines.speaker: Blade Assassin
lines.text: I take what no one will miss. Soon no one will remember you either.
